caption:
MEI Coin-Cell Cold-Chain Simulation — 40/40 safety alerts preserved & 490/500 routine beacons refused in -20 °C simulation (2,680 JCR-1 receipts across 3 temps, est_j)

In datasheet/CAD simulation (est_j, 0 physical tags built), 10 uW over 8 yr = 2.52 kJ — exceeding a cold-derated CR2032 (~2.38 kJ nominal; 0 J unbuffered at -20 C) unless sleep <5 uW or CR2477/Li-SOCl2 is used.
